'''Rendili''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The planet was ruled by an [[Arch-Provost/Legends|Arch-Provost]]. It was the headquarters of [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]], founded in [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and was affiliated with the starshipwrights [[Rendili Hyperworks/Legends|Rendili Hyperworks]],<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards]]<ref name="SW:KOTORH">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> and [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] joint venture. At some point during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] a Republic Military installation housing thousands of troops, vehicles, and starfighters was stationed outside of the major cities, though by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the installation had been all but forgotten.

==History==
It was colonized by [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] sometime after [[27,500 BBY]]. By [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], it had become a military stronghold and was a founder of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3670 BBY]], the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aric Jorgan]] was born on Rendili.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

In [[3000 BBY]], in response to the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|seventeenth]] and final [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflict]], Rendili StarDrive teamed up with [[Vaufthau Shipyards Ltd.]] to produce the [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class dreadnaught]]. The company's peak was c. [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]]. Popular designs included the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] (prior to 100 BBY) and [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ([[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]). In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] it contributed ships and crew to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|paramilitary force]].

With the advent of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in response to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards's]] competitive lead for the Republic new military contracts, [[Arch-Provost/Legends|Arch-Provost]] [[Bengila Urlan]] ordered countless industrial spies and starship designers to design new warships to counter those of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The planet's extensive system of smaller shipyards scattered across the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] gave Rendili StarDrive a temporary ascendancy. Later, the two rival companies teamed up to worked on the [[Victor Initiative Project]] which produced the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}} puts the Battle of Rendili prior to "[[Shadow of Malevolence]]", as part of the compression and rearranging of the pre-''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' timeline of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As "Shadow of Malevolence" is dated to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by {{FactFile2014|24|22 BBY 87-88|The ''Malevolence'' Campaign}}, the Battle of Rendili must also occur in that year.</ref> the planet was taken over by an [[Independent Provisional Government of Rendili|Independent Provisional Government]] that joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A Republic task force [[Battle of Rendili|captured]] the planet's [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet|Home Defense Fleet]], and retook Rendili shortly after. The planet became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Rendili StarDrive signed the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] Imperial charter in the [[Dragonbird Gardens]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. After Rendili StarDrive accepted its last major Imperial contract on [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the planet Rendili joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Rendili StarDrive went on to manufacture the [[Republic-class Star Destroyer|''Republic''-class Star Destroyer]].
